title: Larry Fchella asks Grant's help with a UFO briefing for Reince Priebus

tellings.quote: anyway, he um he called me up and he said after Trump won 2016, he said, "I I need to I I need to help help. We're doing a briefing for Rance Prieous." And I said, "For what UFOs?" He said, "Where are the crafts and bodies?"

plain: After Donald Trump won the 2016 election, a contact named Larry Fchella called with a request: he was helping prepare a UFO briefing for Reince Priebus, a senior figure in the incoming Trump team, and he wanted to know "where are the crafts and bodies?" The researcher Grant Cameron tells this as the man who took the call. If it happened, it would mean someone near the new White House was asking where recovered craft and bodies were kept.
